shouldFix.title: The matrix-authoring plan omits DR-125's explicit activation gate
shouldFix.detail: D-007 routes the manifest/DR-125 dual boundary to the matrix-authoring and DR-125 closure acts (OBS-D007-T2-02). The recorded v13 source is stronger still: matrixShape.capabilityBoundary says DR-125 is OPEN and its closure is an activation gate for matrix authoring, while matrixShape.dr125ActivationGate says matrix authoring waits on that closure or its disposition. File 08 confirms DR-125 remains OPEN, and D-110 only recorded component-sdk-contract.v4 as CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING. The join inventories the other v13 cross-row dependencies at OBL-DR006-RIDES and OBL-G14-DR119, but contains no DR-125 obligation or even a DR-125 mention. Its proposed later work consequently says a later cycle may author the matrix/corpus without stating the source-mandated prerequisite. The candidate still refuses closure and authoring, so this is not a blocker, but the claimed leftover/dependency partition and later-work plan are incomplete.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Add a distinct non-leftover external dependency such as OBL-DR125-CAPABILITY-BOUNDARY, with rideStanding rides-DR-125 and the live standing OPEN / D-110 candidate binds NOTHING. Add it to deferredOrRidesElsewhere and condition the matrix/corpus authoring step on DR-125 closure or its scoped disposition. State that neither this join nor D-110 applies the candidate or turns its proposed host capability declaration into a live vocabulary. Do not close DR-125, apply D-110, author the matrix, or extend the role list.

summary: REJECT at 0 blockers and 1 SHOULD-FIX. The candidate correctly preserves DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED as DR-118's live token, leaves thresholds, matrix/corpus authoring, and the reserved G13 route open, refuses Class B SATISFIED, keeps G13 outside required-now, mints no thresholds or Rust role, and exercises no gate or implementation authority. Its internal nine-obligation partition is structurally consistent, but it is not source-exhaustive: D-007 and recorded v13 make OPEN DR-125 an activation gate that matrix authoring must wait on, while the join inventories DR-006 and DR-119 rides but omits DR-125 and presents matrix/corpus authoring as later work without that prerequisite. No subject, source, file-08, COORD, threshold, matrix, corpus, gate, D9, section-7.1, role, SATISFIED, or implementation mutation was performed by this review.

consideredAndDeclined.item: Escalating the missing DR-125 route to a blocker
consideredAndDeclined.whyDeclined: The omission makes the inventory and later-work plan incomplete, but the candidate still refuses closure, keeps gates 2 and 3 false, records no SATISFIED act, and authors nothing. A mandatory successor repair is proportionate.

consideredAndDeclined.item: Treating the recorded component-sdk v4 candidate as satisfying the DR-125 activation gate
consideredAndDeclined.whyDeclined: D-110 recorded it as CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, and file 08 keeps DR-125 OPEN. Using its proposed capability declaration as live would apply a candidate by implication.

consideredAndDeclined.item: Charging a separate G13 harness-specification obligation in addition to OBL-MATRIX-CORPUS and OBL-G13-RESERVED

A later naming act must be remeasured before D-056 eligibility; this review does not invent a speculative harness artifact.
